parameters.subject: JobFrank is live on Product Hunt today
parameters.message:
Today is the day.

JobFrank is live on Product Hunt and your support means everything. If you have 30 seconds, an upvote helps us reach more job seekers.

Vote for JobFrank on Product Hunt

The app is fully live. Paste any job description and resume — we tailor it in minutes using only your confirmed experience.

Try it now

Thank you for being here from the start.
